伊号第四〇一潜水舰（日语：伊号第四〇一潜水艦，简称伊401）为第二次世界大战时期大日本帝国海军旗下潜水舰。本舰为伊四〇〇型潜水舰的二号舰。正式名称为“伊号第四百一潜水舰”。
本舰于1945年（昭和20年）1月8日竣工，但此时日本战败几乎已经是定局。尽管如此，在终战前的7月20日，仍然为了对美国海军机动部队的泊地乌利西环礁发动进攻而从舞鹤出港，7月23日从大凑出击。第1潜水队司令有泉龙之介大佐以指挥官身份搭乘，舰长由南部伸清少佐担任。
据航海日志记载，伊401曾遇到一次暴风雨的袭击，原定与僚舰伊号第四〇〇潜水舰在中途会合，但并未达成。原计划同伊号第四〇〇潜水舰在8月17日发动进攻，但在攻击开始之前就迎来终战，在当地收到投降命令。舰内成员在自沉和进攻两种选择中激烈讨论，最终由舰长决定返航。由于舰载机需要进行保密而在海上进行了销毁处置。在返航途中的8月29日被美军在海上接收。
本舰在落入美军手中进行研究和实验后，1946年5月31日在珍珠港附近沉船处分。

Having played together a lot when they were younger, they grew apart as they got older. Our hero has to watch someone he once shared a strong bond become a school idol, having many (including girls and teachers) confess to her. In the barren wasteland that is their school, she’s a lone flower which managed to bloom.

Among Miyuki's vast array of talents, batting is one of them. She's rarely seen without her bat, and can often be found at the town's local batting center practicing her swings. Unsurprisingly, wherever Miyuki goes her bat isn’t too far from her. Although, there are suspect rumors involving it...

Given that she’s a character who focuses on getting in contact with god through her chants of "touarururururu~"s, it's no wonder that Aoi is someone whose presence isn't noticed by others – or rather, ignored. A classmate of Shin'ichi and Miyuki's, her brain is full of nothing but games. Going beyond casual jokes and spouting dated memes like other visual novel savvy characters, there's something inherently destructive about the way our mysterious little denpa darling has to liken everything in their lives to a visual novel. Shin'ichi and Miyuki have a stunted conversation? That's a flag. A friendship defining moment happens? You better save to relive the memory later, because the OP is probably going to play any minute now.

Poor at socializing, both Shin'ichi and Miyuki feel like she's unable to draw a line between reality and visual novels, having them seamlessly merge. While she may seem like a poorly written denpa character coming off as deliberately unhinged from the outset, the reader can't help but wonder if there's more to her than meets her clouded eyes.

Influenced by human culture, her interests are very otaku-oriented, and she's so fond of kogals that she bought a tanning bed just to look like one. Her favorite food is fried tofu... actually, no, make that mayonnaise.

Very much a product of modern society, Onatsu likes to browse the web, play multiplayer online games, and also maintains a food blog. She also sells cosplay photo albums online that feature herself and her best friend Otama. The two of them utilize their shape-shifting prowess to spice up their photoshoots.
She's been acquainted with Kouta's family line for many, many decades (perhaps centuries), and she tends to get along particularly well with middle-aged men.
